description: Link Trip→Stay→Place / Event→Person (graph, not prose). link_type accepts documented aliases (e.g. participant → event_person); unknown values error instead of silently becoming "other". Pass status=confirmed|rejected to record a human decision on an existing (often inferred) edge. status=confirmed on a link that does not exist yet creates it, as a call without status does (explicit, confidence 1). status=rejected on a link that does not exist errors and saves nothing: there is nothing to reject. ($0.10; API key required)

confidence.description: 0-1. Defaults to 1 for explicit links. 0 means rejected: every read leaves the edge out.

link_type.description: trip_stay | trip_flight | stay_place | event_place | event_person | transaction_trip | event_event | other. Aliases: participant/participants/attendee/attendees → event_person.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

status.description: confirmed: confirm an existing edge (usually an inferred one: +confirmed, confidence 1), or create the edge if it does not exist yet, as a call without status does. rejected: tombstone an existing edge (+rejected, confidence 0). A rejected edge is not a relationship: the event's people, timelines, get_interactions and every other read leave it out. It is kept so automated writers never recreate it; linking the same pair again without status replaces it. Errors and saves nothing when the edge does not exist.

name: link_entities

confirmation.description: Derived from the link source and confidence. explicit: a direct write; pending: an inferred guess nobody has confirmed; confirmed: a guess a person confirmed; rejected: a person rejected it (source ends in +rejected, or confidence 0). A rejected link is kept only so it is never proposed again; it is not a relationship.

title: Link Entities
